arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import *
from glom.reduction import Fold, Merge
from glom.streaming import Iter
from glom.mutation import Assign

# Check all public specifier types for __repr__
specs = [
    ('Auto()', Auto()),
    ('Check()', Check()),
    ('Call(F)', Call(lambda x: x)),
    ('Coalesce(1, 2)', Coalesce(1, 2)),
    ('Fill(3)', Fill(3)),
    ('Fold(T[0], init=list)', Fold(T[0], init=list)),
    ('Inspect()', Inspect()),
    ('Iter([1,2,3])', Iter([1,2,3])),
    ('Merge(T[\"a\"])', Merge(T['a'])),
    ('Assign(\"a.b\", \"v\")', Assign('a.b', 'v')),
]

for name, spec in specs:
    try:
        print(f'{name}: {repr(spec)}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: ERROR - {e}')
"
